recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Any future cleanup of unused ruleset terminology source files or OID entries should be handled as separate maintenance, not as required FHIR-7775 reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-7775 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Financial Management change request from the DSTU1 ballot. It asked to remove FM resource ruleSet/originalRuleset elements because the business need was expected to be met by Resource.implicitRules and Meta.profile.
initial_application: Historical source commits show the issue was applied before publication: 84584d1c5f1c075ba6140aee7a360c216e3eed3b marked ruleset/originalRuleset rows as deleted across the relevant FM resource spreadsheets, and 13534944609a7a29cd453f21a0fbcde8c6f0bd22 commented the Ruleset terminology binding out of source/terminologies/bindings.xml.
additional_context: Current fhir.ini lists the active current financial resources and comments ProcessRequest/ProcessResponse as retired, while mapping CoverageEligibilityRequest/Response from the old EligibilityRequest/Response names. Active current financial source folders have no live ruleset/originalRuleset rows. Remaining matches are bang-prefixed deleted rows in retired process/eligibility spreadsheets or stale terminology XML/OID source that is not linked from bindings.xml and is not rendered at current/R5 ruleset value set or code system URLs. Current Resource.implicitRules and Meta.profile definitions provide the intended common mechanisms.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current specification already omits the FM-specific business-rule elements and retains the common implicitRules/profile mechanisms, so deleting out-of-build stale files would not change current spec semantics.
